answer: Work waits on the juniper until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the knoll of the next round. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a checklist tone, short verdict at the end register, it stays short. Reaching the zephyr of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
